machine: 3-axis VMC / desktop mill, Ø6 mm flat end mill as the smallest cutter (shop template, not a calibrated machine)
description: 3-axis CNC finishing of a sand-cast WCB valve body: wall/feature/gap, circular-bore cutter radius (Ø6 mm) and hole aspect (depth/diameter). Applied to the geometry AFTER casting, never to the pattern. Non-circular pockets/slots, undercuts, minimum internal radius, setups/fixturing, chatter and cost are handoffs; the report says so whenever toolRadiusMm is declared.

source.ref: thin-wall milling of cast steel: ~3 mm minimum machined wall

wallMinMm.detail: The wall left after the as-cast skin is removed. Below ~3 mm the wall deflects and rings under a Ø6 cutter.

source.ref: machined pins/ribs below ~2 mm deflect or break under a Ø6 cutter
derived from the smallest cutter: a slot narrower than 2 x toolRadiusMm (6 mm) cannot be milled with it

gapMinMm.detail: Derived, not an independent measurement: gapMinMm = 2 x toolRadiusMm. Non-circular slots are otherwise NOT reachability-checked, only this width floor applies.

overhangDeg.reason: CNC removes material; there is no support overhang.

bridgeMaxMm.reason: Material removal creates no unsupported span.

source.ref: HSS drill 4:1 conservative; carbide and peck drilling go deeper

draftMinDeg.reason: No mold release in machining; draft does not govern this process.

escapePassageMinMm.reason: No trapped powder or resin to evacuate.

source.ref: Ø6 mm end mill is the smallest cutter this shop will use - a shop decision, not a measured capability

toolRadiusMm.detail: Circular bores only: a bore radius below the cutter radius cannot be entered. Non-circular pockets/slots are NOT covered - that is a disclosed gap, not a pass.

source.ref: 3-axis mill on cast steel, ±0.1 mm typical for a ~100 mm part

tolMm.detail: A capability; excluding on it needs a tolerance requirement declared elsewhere.

source.ref: end-milled WCB Ra ~1.6-3.2 um; tool marks dominate

surfaceRaUm.detail: Reported for information only; never used to exclude.

notes: DRAFT, authored 2026-11-17 for ball-valve-dn100 and NOT calibrated. This is the second half of a cast-then-machined body: screen the finished geometry here and the as-cast geometry against sand-casting-wcb - screening the pattern against cutter rules, or the finished part against draft rules, is a wrong ruler. Machining allowance has no schema rule field: as-cast skin/scale means ~2-3 mm per machined face must be reserved on the pattern, stated here and in sand-casting-wcb. Every number is a rule-of-thumb except gapMinMm, which is derived from the 6 mm cutter. `not-excluded` means no circular bore was too narrow and no wall was below 3 mm - never that the body can be machined.
